subject: [PATCH v5 07/15] SUNRPC: stop svc_register() once rpcbind stops answering

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch modifies the svc_register() function in the SUNRPC module to stop registering programs when rpcbind does not respond. The original implementation would continue trying to register other programs even if one program's call timed out, resulting in unnecessary delays. This change improves performance by breaking out of the loop as soon as a program fails to respond.
